reason: Mounting the lens in its sliding holder seems like a useful first step toward focusing the stars.
expectation: I expect a lens assembly whose position can be adjusted, though it may need other parts before it projects anything.

alternatives.reason: The cloth will provide a projection surface, but I chose to prepare the focusing mechanism first.

effect: The adjustable lens assembly is ready; the projection cloth is the only offered gameplay action.
reaction: The result was expected, with no detail yet about focusing.
reason: I'll set up the cloth as the surface for the projected stars.
expectation: I expect the cloth to be positioned for projection, though the lens may still need fitting.

effect: The cloth reveals that the turning image is blurry, so the lens is the next step toward focus.
reaction: The moving blobs make the need for focusing clear.
reason: The lens assembly is the only offered gameplay action and should help sharpen the image.
expectation: I expect to fit the adjustable lens and possibly bring the stars into focus, though further adjustment may be needed.

effect: The sliding lens focuses an image of the star holes on the cloth; the hood is the only offered gameplay action.
reaction: The explanation makes the lens's role clearer.
reason: I'll fit the hood, presumably to reduce stray light around the projection.
expectation: I expect the hood to improve the image's visibility, though I'm not sure how much difference it will make.

effect: The hood is fitted, and the star-wheel handle is the only offered gameplay action.
reaction: The result gives no detail about what difference the hood made.
reason: I'll fit the handle so the star wheel can be turned.
expectation: I expect the handle to let me turn the projected stars, possibly completing the goal.

effect: The handle completed the turning star theatre, and the final image revealed that the projection is upside down.
reaction: The upside-down sky was a pleasing surprise, and the whale connection gives the earlier inventions a shared purpose.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the focusing lens was most worthwhile: it explained how sliding the lens brings an image of the star holes onto the cloth.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the hood felt least informative because the result did not show or explain its effect.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the projected sky appeared upside down.

arbitrary.text: The hood had a plausible purpose, but its effect remained unclear in the result; the other actions had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. The lens explanation made the construction worth my time, and the hints of a whale carrying the fair make me curious about how the inventions will come together.
